description: Header file defining the GPUObject interface and GPUResourcesWithValue struct for Metal GPU delegate in TensorFlow Lite, including resource management methods and data structures used for GPU resource handling.
external_methods: absl::Status GetGPUResources(const GPUObjectDescriptor* obj_ptr, GPUResourcesWithValue* resources) const

classes.name: GPUObject
classes.description: Abstract base class for GPU objects in Metal GPU delegate, requiring implementation of resource retrieval.

methods.name: GetGPUResources
methods.description: Pure virtual function to obtain GPU resources associated with a specific GPU object descriptor.

methods.description: Adds a float value to the generic GPU resources.

methods.name: AddInt
methods.description: Adds an integer value to the generic GPU resources.
